title: ADA Pubs+
html:
Trust is the foundation of a successful dental practice. However, skepticism among patients—especially regarding diagnoses—can create barriers to treatment acceptance. This whitepaper outlines five key steps to fostering patient confidence, increasing case acceptance, and ultimately boosting practice revenue. From uniting your team and leveraging advanced technology to educating patients and offering better payment options, these strategies will help ensure patients feel informed, valued, and are ready to say “yes” to recommended treatments. 

This whitepaper covers: 

  • Ensuring every touchpoint in a practice builds patient confidence
  • Explaining the necessity and benefits of proposed
  • Leveraging cutting-edge technology to enhance trust and treatment acceptance
  • Making complex diagnoses easier to understand
  • Removing financial barriers to care
